commentary: Today, iron ore futures fell back from highs, with the most-traded I2505 contract closing at 812 yuan/mt, up 1.10% for the day. Traders showed weak enthusiasm for selling. Steel mills adopted a more cauƟous senƟment, and market transacƟon acƟvity was moderate. In Shandong, mainstream transacƟon prices for PB ﬁnes were 800-804 yuan/mt, down 5-10 yuan/mt from yesterday. In Tangshan, PB ﬁnes transacƟon prices were around 820 yuan/mt, down 10 yuan/mt from yesterday. Today, Trump announced a 25% tariﬀ on steel and aluminum imports from all countries. Following the conﬁrmaƟon of this news, concerns over potenƟal obstacles to direct or indirect steel exports intensiﬁed, market senƟment deteriorated, and some bulls took proﬁts, leading to a decline in iron ore futures prices. Fundamentally, SMM's weekly maintenance data showed that this week's impact from maintenance increased by 62,300 mt, up WoW. Maintenance impact is expected to further increase next week, with iron ore supply pulling back aŌer a temporary increase.
